description: Search stock photos on Pexels (default) or Pixabay. Write query in English, such as "coffee shop" or "city night"; translate other languages first. orientation is all, landscape, portrait or square; Pixabay photos take no square. Each result has width, height, a full-size image_url, a smaller preview_url, the author and credit_url. Tell the user who made what you use. Page with pages from the answer: Pixabay drops photos of the wrong shape, so a page can hold fewer than per_page. guide, when present, says how to search again.

query.description: English words for the subject or scene

name: search_photos
